description: This PHP source file defines the Goteo Console Command class 'OpenDataCommand,' which generates open data CSV files for projects, investments, calls, SDGs, footprints, and channels. It includes methods for extracting and exporting data, managing datasets, and handling file uploads via the FileHandler library. The command can be invoked with specific options to extract data for calls, SDGs, footprints, or channels.

classes.name: OpenDataCommand
classes.description: A console command class that provides functionality to generate and export open data CSV files for various entities such as projects, investments, calls, SDGs, footprints, and channels. It manages data extraction, file handling, and dataset updates.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's name, description, options, and help message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method invoked when the command runs; handles option parsing and calls appropriate data extraction methods.

methods.name: extractSdgOpenData
methods.description: Extracts open data for a given SDG, including projects and investments.

methods.name: extractSdgProjects
methods.description: Generates CSV for projects filtered by SDG and uploads as a dataset.

methods.name: extractSdgInvests
methods.description: Generates CSV for investments filtered by SDG and uploads as a dataset.

methods.name: extractFootprintOpenData
methods.description: Extracts open data for a footprint, including projects and investments.

methods.name: extractFootprintProjects
methods.description: Generates CSV for projects linked to a footprint and uploads.

methods.name: extractFootprintInvests
methods.description: Generates CSV for investments linked to a footprint and uploads.

methods.name: extractCallOpenData
methods.description: Extracts open data for a call, including projects and investments.

methods.name: extractCallProjectsData
methods.description: Generates CSV for projects associated with a call.

methods.name: extractCallInvestsData
methods.description: Generates CSV for investments associated with a call.

methods.name: extractChannelOpenData
methods.description: Extracts open data for a channel, including projects and investments.

methods.name: extractChannelProjects
methods.description: Generates CSV for projects associated with a channel.

methods.name: extractChannelInvests
methods.description: Generates CSV for investments associated with a channel.

methods.name: extractProjectOpenData
methods.description: Creates and writes CSV data for a list of projects.

methods.name: extractInvestOpenData
methods.description: Creates and writes CSV data for a list of investments.

methods.name: extractDataForCall
methods.description: Handles extraction of data for specified calls or all calls if none specified.

methods.name: extractDataForSdg
methods.description: Handles extraction of data for specified SDGs or all SDGs if none specified.

methods.name: extractDataForFootprint
methods.description: Handles extraction of data for specified footprints or all if none specified.

methods.name: extractDataForChannel
methods.description: Handles extraction of data for specified channels or all if none specified.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Generates a timestamped filename for CSV exports based on entity ID and type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Creates and configures a file object for uploading CSV data to external storage.

methods.name: createDataSet
methods.description: Creates a new dataset record in the repository for a given model and CSV file.

methods.name: updateDataSet
methods.description: Updates an existing dataset with a new file URL.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message when file upload fails.

methods.name: logCompleted
methods.description: Logs a message indicating successful file upload.
